detail: Minneapolis land-use district: DT1 Downtown Center.

The code, §530.410: “The DT1 Downtown Center District is established to provide an environment for retail and office activities of citywide and regional significance at the center of downtown. The district also allows entertainment, residential, and public uses, which complete the mixed-use core of the city.”
